newsitem.title: INDIA: State firms offerings curb Indian cotton prices.
newsitem.headline: State firms offerings curb Indian cotton prices.

text.p: Higher offering by Indian state firms curbed cotton prices from gaining on Friday, dealers said.
In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan fell by 400/500 rupees to 13,600/13,700 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) while wagad cotton fell by 300/400 rupees to 11,700/11,800 rupees.
Bengal-deshi spot delivery fell by 35 rupees to 840/865 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while October delivery was quoted at 900 rupees.
The cotton markets are closed on Monday and Tuesday, both local religious festivals in India.
